item.title: Version 1.1.0-beta (82)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.1.0-beta

Build 82

  • Find unusable shows those frames in the library, with a thumbnail and a reason. Look at them, then archive or trash the ones you choose.
  • Command-click adds a photo. Shift-click selects a range.
  • Archive stays in the sidebar, locked, next to Favorites.
  • See trailsrg.com/apps/studio/versions for full notes.
